description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class for the 'analytics' extension module within the OpenCart admin area. It contains methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling the analytics extension, including permission checks and dynamic loading of extension components.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'analytics' extension in the OpenCart admin panel, handling listing, installation, and uninstallation processes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method to display the list view of available analytics extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view listing available and installed analytics extensions, with actions for install/uninstall.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a specified analytics extension, including permissions, loading extension files, and registering permissions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a specified analytics extension, including permissions and cleanup actions.
